subject: CMake: fail on warnings (#1503)
reason: The change only adds -Werror -Wall to the CMake build and an unreachable 'return NULL' after assert(0) in valkey-cli's jsonStringOutput to silence the resulting warning. jsonStringOutput is only called with OUTPUT_JSON or OUTPUT_QUOTED_JSON, both of which return earlier, so the new statement never executes and no binary's runtime behavior, replies, or output change. This is a build/CI change with no testable behavior difference.
